pages.title: Cryogenic Survival
pages.text: $(thing)Cryogenic Survival$()$(br2)At 94 K the trick is not to make heat but to keep it. Unlocks the Heated Pressure Suit and the Hydrophobic Coating that keeps methane rain out of its lining.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Titan, Calorimetry.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Tholin Sand, 4 Silica Aerogel.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Heat leaks through a slab of insulation of thermal conductivity k, area A and thickness l, with a difference T between the temperatures of its faces. Write the heat flow q.
